Daily reset: everything is disconnected and every sender reset until 12:00 UTC. Traffic reconnects then.

Public snapshot of the Trunk-Caster pages, refreshed when published. Live controls need the running caster: open http://127.0.0.1:8080 while the runtime is serving for live controls.

Any to any

Direct trunk when there is one with room or both frames have a free caster; otherwise the router goes via another frame. The user ports take the caller's name. A request can also be dropped as JSON into TRUNK-CASTER-INTERFACE.
